title: 1934 Auto Interior, Hot Rod Steering Wheel - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A close-up interior snapshot of a 1934 automobile, likely customized as a classic hot rod. The image shows the pleated vinyl bench seat and matching door panel, a dash with retro instrumentation, an auxiliary gauge clamped to the steering column, and a three-spoke sports steering wheel with drilled lightening holes. The back includes a handwritten note identifying it as 'inside '34'.
